title: AI Phone Answering Bots for Funeral Homes
summary: Butch Ewing describes an AI bot that answers the phone for funeral homes around the clock.

chapters.title: Death Tech and the Phone Problem
An AI Bot Answers the Call
Phone Menus vs a Useful Bot

learn: Funeral homes have to answer the phone 24/7, and nights and weekends often go to third-party call services.
The bot takes the call, collects the caller's information and passes it to the funeral home.
He says call services cost $1,500 to $2,000 a month, and the bot gives round-the-clock answering at a fraction of that.
In a pilot three years ago, 95% or more of callers were fine with the bot; the goal had been 40%.
The system uses Python and LangChain, with text to speech and speech to text.
